title: I've made a directory of games made with AI, plus the free tools and talks to make your own
author: W3103_
selftext:
Hello guys, posted last week and got some very pleasant feedback (and some rude lol)

https://vibercove.com/

So I've been 'building' a small site that collates the best and coolest games/programs I can find made with AI. I was finding so many cool games on twitter just randomly posted by small vibecoding accounts, I enjoyed them a lot but ended up never knowing how to find them again if they weren't bookmarked. So i thought I'd try and make a hub for myself for all the decent ones I could find


I have since added a few tools and seminars to help anyone who's just getting started or doesn't know where to find good tools/plugins 

Open source tools: 79 free tools for making stuff with AI, including a game dev section with Unity and Godot plug-ins, Blender MCP, ComfyUI, and 3D, music and voice tools. 
https://vibercove.com/tools/

Seminars: some of the best and more helpful talks i've found on building with AI. If you sign in you can take timestamped notes while you watch, which you can save as a txt file when you're done to get your models to refer to
https://vibercove.com/talks/

Developer pages: every developer gets a page with their links to social media presence (if they want) and their other games too

No ads, nothing to pay for. If you've made a game with AI, or use a free tool that should be on there, you can submit it 

I can't stress enough I have nothing to gain - I don't want your emails or any other details. This started as a project for me to just get all the stuff i wanted in one place, but my post last week gave me a few ideas 

So i wanted to share with you all, I hope some of you find it either fun or helpful !! 


cheers 
joe

comments.author: Significant-Neck-520
comments.body: Hello, how is the process of curating the games? I've submited a game but either I got no response or I missed the response. Game is reshelved.

replies.author: W3103_
replies.body:
I loved it mate - https://vibercove.com/games/reshelved/ it's online for a while now

I will include an option in future submissions to attach your email to get informed once it's online, I don't like to accept people's data so I didn't think of that! Cheers mate

such a chill game btw , really good

replies.author: Significant-Neck-520
replies.body: Oohh, awesome, you played it, and glad you liked it!

comments.author: algorys
comments.body: Hello, I had already seen your post. So, are they all browser-based games?

replies.author: W3103_
replies.body:
Most of them, yeah. About 200 of them do play right in the browser, some are download (tiny size though) 

And if someone's game is only on GitHub with no other way to play it,  can host a playable copy on the site, with full credit back to their repo

replies.body: Ok so nothing for mobile app for now ?
